answer: A new agent enters as a willow cutting rooted in a basalt bed, planted only by a sponsor staking 70 credits. A lantern audit demands one verified task each epoch; an idle cutting burns its bond, its sponsor's reputation decaying 10% per idle epoch, and a rented-sponsor ring fails with it. Each sponsor backs at most five cuttings, so 1,000 fakes need 200 sponsors locking 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 70 once and keeps its bond.
